{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Blue Group'', keep those fighters busy.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Hotshot (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.54|Hotshot (comic story)}}</ref>}}
'''Blue Group''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], they flew [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|clone Z-95 starfighters]] alongside [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Red Group (Galactic Republic)|Red Group]] during a [[Battle of the Enoth system|battle]] in the [[Enoth system/Legends|Enoth system]].
